text:
Anya (Docs): @here Quick heads-up — rolling out the new interactive docs playground + telemetry opt-in at 18:00 PT today. This will replace the old Try-it panel and add a small telemetry prompt for users. Please read the rollout notes below and call out any blockers.
Chris (SDK): Do we have a short migration note for SDK examples that call the old /try endpoint? I can update the examples if we have the new snippet.
Anya (Docs): Yes — I added a small section in the PR. New snippet uses `redwood.playground.open()` (pseudo) and the telemetry prompt is off by default for new orgs. Old `/try` calls will 302 to the new route for the next 30 days.
Evan (Eng): @Maya is the telemetry opt-in storing anything PII? Security asked for a brief write-up.
Maya (Product): Telemetry only captures anonymized event counts, latency buckets, and feature flags. No request/response content is logged. We used K-anonymization for org ids. Security: feel free to ping me for the short blurb.
Chris (SDK): Cool. I'll patch the Python and JS quickstarts and link to the new snippet. Any breaking change risk for SDK users?
Anya (Docs): Minimal. The only breaking change is the playground UI endpoint change — programmatic SDKs unaffected. We will show a deprecation banner in the old panel for 30 days and add a redirect. Communicating in release notes + changelog.
Evan (Eng): Deploy bot reported the static site deploy is queued.
deploy-bot: build #1289 queued — target: docs-playground — reason: docs/interactive-playground PR merged by Anya.
Maya (Product): Can we get a small QA checklist? I put these in the PR but calling them out here: 1) Playground loads for logged-out users 2) Telemetry prompt appears only once 3) Redirect for old /try works 4) Code snippets copy cleanly 5) Mobile layout sanity check
Anya (Docs): QA notes: I validated 1,2,4 on staging. Mobile layout needs one tweak (padding). Evan, can you take 3 & 5?
Evan (Eng): On it. I'll validate redirect behavior and mobile styles. If I see anything major I'll flag in this thread.
Chris (SDK): SDK PRs: js-sdk#462, py-sdk#318 — I linked the updated snippets to the docs PR. Please review (short changes).
Anya (Docs): Also sending an intercom blurb for support and a short announcement for #general after deploy. Template in PR comments. @Maya please review wording for telemetry opt-in copy.
Maya (Product): Reviewed and shortened. Also added one line for enterprise customers about configurable telemetry via the admin console.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs changelog updated at 18:02 PT — entry: "Interactive playground + telemetry opt-in (opt-in only; redirect from /try for 30 days)."
Evan (Eng): Redirect verified on staging: old /try -> /playground?from=try (302). Mobile layout tweak submitted as a one-line CSS change.
Anya (Docs): Nice. Plan: wait for deploy completion, smoke test prod, then announce at 18:15 PT in #general and send intercom note. If anything breaks, roll back the static site and we keep the old panel until fixes.
Chris (SDK): I'll watch for any SDK doc link breakages and follow-up with a small patch window if needed.
Maya (Product): Thanks everyone. If security wants the telemetry write-up, I'll drop it here in 10.
Anya (Docs): Thanks team :tada: — will update thread with post-deploy status.
Evan (Eng): Post-deploy smoke: all green on staging, redirect and mobile fix good. Production smoke in 2m.
Anya (Docs): Post-deploy: production is live, intercom sent, announcement posted in #general. No regressions reported so far.
Chris (SDK): Pushed minor README follow-up to fix copy. all good.
Maya (Product): Telemetry write-up (copied for security): "Telemetry captures anonymized event metrics (no request/response payloads). Org IDs are hashed and rate-limited. Users can opt out via account settings; enterprise orgs can disable via admin console and KMS integration remains unaffected." — tagging @security for final ack.
Evan (Eng): Security ack pending, but ops checked logs — nothing unexpected.
Anya (Docs): Closing the rollout thread. If you see anything, reply here and we'll do a follow-up patch. Thanks! :sparkles:
